art_direction_concept: Cairo Visual Identity Direction: 'Luxury Cyber-Editorial with Royal Obsidian and Ultraviolet tones'. A dramatic blend of deep Obsidian backgrounds, high-voltage Ultraviolet highlights, and warm Champagne Gold accents symbolizing prestige.

color_system.name: Deep Obsidian
color_system.usage: Primary canvas background and solid structural panels

color_system.name: Vibrant Purple
color_system.usage: Hero brand accents, active states, and glowing gradients

color_system.name: Champagne Gold
color_system.usage: Luxury badges, key metric highlights, and executive seals

typography_hierarchy.primary_font: IBM Plex Sans Arabic (Bold / SemiBold) for Arabic, Inter for English
typography_hierarchy.secondary_font: Noto Sans Arabic (Regular / Medium) for body text

asset_specifications.safe_zones: Top 250px and bottom 350px reserved for UI controls

design_rules: Maintain minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio across all text layers
Never stretch or alter the aspect ratio of brand logotypes
Use subtle 1px border glows (rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.3)) on dark containers
